name: PX-478
decisive_datum: the axis, not the compound: Wwox-deficient cells show HIF-1alpha protein and HIF target genes up and HIF-1alpha knockdown rescues the metabolic phenotype (non-neural, Abu-Remaileh 2014); the human organoid shows EPAS1 3.80x, ARNT 1.46x, HK2 4.73x, SLC2A1 2.67x; PX-478 lowers GLUT-1 in xenografts; against: ChEMBL holds 0 activity rows, structure is a bis(2-chloroethyl)amino N-oxide, adult IV phase 1 only, no CNS or paediatric data
biological_promise: MODERATE for the HIF axis, LOW for this compound
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (3 primary papers read FULL or PASSAGES, 3 abstracts)
feasibility: MEDIUM in vitro (research chemical; supply UNVERIFIED), LOW clinical
identity_state: verified by structure (ChEMBL CHEMBL4117516 = PubChem CID 11234795 by InChIKey; the name hit is the dihydrochloride, CID 11234794)
primary_papers_read: Bruick 2000 (FULL); Abu-Remaileh 2014 (existing receipt, PASSAGES); Welsh 2004, Koh 2008, PX-478 ASD rat 2024 (ABSTRACT)
next_experiment: In WWOX-deficient human neural cells (KO organoids at week 8-15 or hNPC): HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown (primary, genetic) with PX-478 as the pharmacological arm at graded concentrations beside a non-mustard HIF-1alpha inhibitor and an inactive-mustard control; readouts HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein, lactate/ECAR and glucose uptake, glycolytic module genes BEYOND the six IT7 readout genes (PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PFKP, PKM), SOX2/NEUN fractions, viability
falsifier: knockdown does not move glycolytic module genes or lactate in KO cells (HIF-independent), or HIF-1alpha protein is not higher in KO than WT neural cells
unverified: HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein in WWOX-deficient neural cells (never measured); PX-478 supply and purity; phase I results not retrieved; the ASD-rat paper read as abstract only

name: roxadustat
decisive_datum: the proposal pushes the seeds in the disease direction by construction (mimics); its chain is not what the compound does (HIF stabilisation is the direct route, EGLN1 IC50 14-5740 nM; no EGLN2 row), the FOXO3 -> SLC2A1 reference states repression; and the EU label lists seizures as common (1.1-2.0 vs 0.2-1.6), thyromimetic action (EC50 THRB 12.9 nM, THRA 32.7 nM in ChEMBL), brain necrosis in rats at 3-6x AUC, no paediatric data
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM-HIGH (label read in the relevant sections, ChEMBL complete, 2 primary papers FULL, 1 abstract)
feasibility: HIGH to obtain (EU, JP, CN approved), but safety-limited
identity_state: verified (ChEMBL CHEMBL2338329 = PubChem by InChIKey YOZBGTLTNGAVFU-UHFFFAOYSA-N)
next_experiment: none for the compound. The question it stands for (does HIF stabilisation phenocopy the KO seeds, and is it already saturated in KO because WWOX loss lowers HIF-1alpha hydroxylation?) is carried by the E-01 experiment with a prolyl hydroxylase inhibitor lacking thyromimetic action (molidustat per the 2025 report) and genetic VHL or EGLN1 loss
unverified: EGLN2 potency of roxadustat (no row); FOXO3 -> SLC2A1 second reference (29301589) not examined beyond its abstract; roxadustat brain penetration (no datum)

name: nirogacestat
decisive_datum: the chain's two records are family-level credits: gamma-secretase -> NOTCH3 cites a review that never names NOTCH3, and NICD1/NICD3/RBPJ -> MYC cites a NOTCH1 T-ALL paper that tests only NOTCH1; plus adults only (label), epiphyseal disorder in paediatric patients with open growth plates, embryo-fetal toxicity, no CNS or seizure datum; the seed (MYC) has no established valence
biological_promise: LOW (the MYC link belongs to NOTCH1; the class lowers c-myc mRNA in T-ALL but that is not neural)
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM-HIGH (label and ChEMBL complete, 1 primary paper FULL, 1 review PASSAGES)
feasibility: MEDIUM-HIGH in access (approved adult drug), LOW for a developing-brain system (no paediatric safety)
identity_state: verified (ChEMBL CHEMBL1770916 = PubChem by InChIKey VFCRKLWBYMDAED-REWPJTCUSA-N)
primary_papers_read: Palomero 2006 (FULL); gamma-secretase review 2014 (PASSAGES); semagacestat phase 3 (ABSTRACT, class-level)
next_experiment: none for this compound. A class-level question (does gamma-secretase inhibition lower MYC and raise neuronal fractions in KO radial glia?) is the same experiment as the MYC-specific lever of the seed assessment and needs no drug
unverified: nirogacestat CNS exposure (not in the label); NOTCH3 protein in radial glia (HPA adult class only)

name: STM2457
role: mechanism probe (tool compound; STC-15 is the clinical sibling, no ChEMBL identity)
decisive_datum: genetic METTL3/METTL14 loss impairs generation of human neural progenitors and prevents neuronal differentiation (2025), and m6A depletion prolongs the radial glia cell cycle and extends neurogenesis in mouse cortex (Yoon 2017): the opposite of the differentiation the MYC-lowering reading wants; the edges come from GIST cells and glioma stem cells
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (3 papers PASSAGES, 2 abstracts; ChEMBL 1 row)
feasibility: LOW (research tool, no human exposure, no CNS datum)
identity_state: ChEMBL CHEMBL5405231 = PubChem CID 168310317 by InChIKey; the PubChem NAME hit is a constitutional isomer (CID 155167581); structure in the primary paper not inspected: treated as UNVERIFIED against the paper
edge_grade: CANCER_LINE_RECORD (METTL3 -> USP13) and PLAUSIBLE_NEURAL_LINEAGE_TUMOUR (USP13 -> MYC protein)
primary_papers_read: Yankova 2021, Yoon 2017, METTL3/14 human neural fate 2025 and the GIST paper (PASSAGES); Fang 2017 (PASSAGES); neuroblastoma STM2457 paper (ABSTRACT plus search)
unverified: paper structure of STM2457; MYC protein result in Yankova Fig. 2g; STC-15 identity

name: D4476

decisive_datum: the kinase -> FOXO6 edges come from a family-level review that names FOXO6 twice and reports no FOXO6 experiment; in WWOX-KO organoids FOXO6 is lower (0.57x) while MYC is higher, the opposite co-movement to the FOXO6 -> MYC sign; D4476 inhibits CK1 delta/epsilon, CK1 alpha (300-321 nM) and ALK5 (500 nM) with no DYRK1A row
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (ChEMBL 46 rows; 1 review PASSAGES; 2 abstracts; local organoid rows)
feasibility: LOW-MEDIUM in vitro (commercial probe, supply UNVERIFIED); no human exposure
identity_state: verified (ChEMBL CHEMBL410456 = PubChem by InChIKey DPDZHVCKYBCJHW-UHFFFAOYSA-N)
primary_papers_read: forkhead review 2009 (PASSAGES); FoxO6 hippocampus paper 2012 (PASSAGES); gastric and colorectal FOXO6 papers (ABSTRACT)
next_experiment: none for the compound. The edge itself is a one-step genetic question (FOXO6 knockdown or overexpression in KO radial glia, read MYC); the local data predict no effect or the opposite sign, so it is not proposed
unverified: FOXO6 protein in organoid cells (HPA: protein not detected in adult; mRNA present in organoid); hNPC table lacks FOXO6

name: sulfopin
role: mechanism probe (research probe with in vivo data and an inactive control)
decision: KEEP-AS-PROPOSAL (mechanistic; conditional on the seed valence experiment)
decisive_datum: PIN1 acts on MYC protein stability and activity, and sulfopin is a highly selective covalent PIN1 probe (Ki 17-700 nM in ChEMBL, two chemoproteomic methods) that lowers Myc target genes, with in vivo activity in MYCN-driven neuroblastoma models; against: the CollecTRI 'transcriptional' label is a mode mislabel for the transcript seed, none of the ten reference abstracts reports MYC mRNA after PIN1 manipulation, no CNS exposure datum, no human exposure
biological_promise: LOW-MODERATE (protein or activity level, MYC valence unknown)
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (1 primary paper PASSAGES, 1 review PASSAGES, ChEMBL 12 rows)
feasibility: MEDIUM in vitro (probe, inactive control, oral mouse PK), LOW clinical
identity_state: verified (ChEMBL CHEMBL5397880 = PubChem CID 155804394 by InChIKey NMHVAHHYKGXBMY-UHFFFAOYSA-N)
edge_grade: MODE_MISLABELLED (transcript seed); plausible for MYC protein
primary_papers_read: Dubiella 2021 (PASSAGES); PIN1 control of MYC review 2020 (PASSAGES); nine further PIN1 reference abstracts
next_experiment: In KO and patient-derived organoids at the week used for the A51 test (week 8 to 15): sulfopin versus its inactive analogue Sulfopin-AcA at concentrations that engage PIN1 in the cells, beside a MYC-specific lever (degron or OmoMYC); readouts MYC+/SOX2+ fraction, MYC target signature by pseudobulk, pH3+ fraction of SOX2+, NEUN+ and SATB2+ fractions, PIN1 target engagement (competition pulldown)
falsifier: no fall of the MYC+ fraction or the MYC target signature at engaged concentrations, or neuronal fractions do not move with MYC reduction by the specific lever (which would also drop the opposes reading)
unverified: PIN1 engagement concentration in neural cells; brain exposure; supply of the compound
